players.product: Helios AI/HPC data-center campus (West Texas, 800 gross MW) leased to CoreWeave, plus Merlin / Caspian / Selene Texas development sites - ex-Bitcoin-mining site (Galaxy Power)

quarterly_data.signal: Galaxy's Q2 2026 overview presentation describes Helios as 1,630 MW of total approved power capacity on 2,200+ contiguous acres in Dickens County, West Texas, with a path to 3,600+ MW of total potential power capacity; the Q2 release says the Helios III and Helios IV requests together represent potential total capacity of 3.6 GW. As of July 2026 the campus's privately owned 345 kV grid-connected substation supports up to 900 MW of transformer capacity across various phases, and a chiller yard supplies temperature-controlled water to direct-liquid-cooling systems.
quarterly_data.figure: Helios 1,630 MW approved; 3,600+ MW total potential power capacity; 345 kV substation supporting up to 900 MW of transformer capacity

connects_to.relationship: Helios campus (West Texas) AI data-center capacity leased to CoreWeave - 800 gross MW across three phases (Phase I 133 MW critical IT delivered; Phase II 260 MW; Phase III 133 MW)

contracts.signal: The CoreWeave Lease Overview in Galaxy's Q2 2026 presentation shows a total potential contract value of $30B+ over a total potential lease term of 25 years (800 MW gross power capacity, 526 MW contracted critical IT load). Per the slide's footnote, both figures assume exercise of two five-year extension options beyond the initial 15-year contract term, and the total potential contract value includes the impact of annual escalators.
contracts.units: 526 MW contracted critical IT load / 800 MW gross power capacity
